metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I swear I aimed at the floor and Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did my aim just clock in?
Enemy probably uninstalling mid-air.
Click if your luck’s been weirder than your skill today.
Valorant logic: the gift that keeps on giving.

Tap if your kills confuse even you!
